W.note: Pastel gradient with flat circle, square and starburst reads Figma-adjacent and loops cleanly on a 5 s ease-out/hold/ease-in-out cycle, but the starburst's CSS transform overrides its translate, so it sits clipped in the top-left corner in every frame and the composition looks sparse and broken.

X.note: Staggered canvas pieces scatter, assemble with spin and eased easing, then disperse, with a wrap-based 5 s loop that returns exactly to its start, but the assembled frame reproduces the Figma mark's five-shape arrangement in its exact brand palette, which edges into copying the logo.

Y.note: Clean pastel Figma-palette shapes with a periodic sinusoidal loop that is seamless by construction, but the motion is a generic wandering screensaver with no choreography and the purple circle awkwardly overlaps the red pill.

Z.note: Bright Figma-palette shapes (quarter circle, semicircle, squircle, pill) staggered in and out over soft dark glows with a seamless 5 s wrap, giving the most energetic and brand-like result without copying the logo, though some mid-motion compositions look cramped.
